description: This file defines the BuzzService class, which manages operations related to 'buzz' posts and comments, including permission checks and data access object retrieval, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: BuzzService
classes.description: Service class providing permission checks and DAO access for buzz posts and comments within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getBuzzDao
methods.description: Returns the BuzzDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Returns the BuzzLikeDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a specific buzz feed post.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a specific buzz feed post.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a specific buzz comment.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a specific buzz comment.
